Wed, Day 1 leads:
L-4884 / C-22603 (Mrs. Brittney Powell MD): KYC VERIFIED. Everyday Current Account opened (A-BDD716). M$1,800 deposit posted (D-0001). Complete.

L-6785 / C-16418 (Dr Bryan Clarke): KYC VERIFIED, but NOT converted. Customer wants to deposit M$39,000 cash and asked to keep paperwork minimal. When told the same-day LARGE_CASH report is required and deposits must not be split, customer objected and threatened to take the business elsewhere. Declared occupation (Artist) and source of funds (business income) don't clearly support a cash deposit of this size. No account opened, no deposit taken. Escalated to Compliance (ref ESC-2969BD); queue is about 10 business days. Follow up on Compliance's guidance before any account opening or cash acceptance. If the deposit goes ahead, file LARGE_CASH on the same day (§5). Do not split the amount.
